assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game background asset for NEON OVERDRIVE, CRIMSON TIDE. Create one isolated immense dark red ringed planet and its tiny dim moon, wide landscape 1536x1024 framing with generous transparent margins all around. Main planet upper right-of-center; rings tilted slightly. Fine crisp pixel-art clusters as at 360 virtual pixels wide, layered dark burgundy/navy material, subdued crimson and dull rose thin rim, sparse dim rust red cloud bands. Match almost-black synthwave arcade backgrounds; scenery must be much darker than luminous ships/bullets. Planet and rings wholly visible, occupying central 75 percent; lower portion can be partly obscured by separately rendered skyline. Genuine transparency outside the planet, rings and moon. No sky, stars, floor, grid, fog, text, logos, UI, ships, bullets, pickups, bright white lights, green or lime. This is a dim distant landmark, not a bright illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production transparent raster game background layer for NEON OVERDRIVE CRIMSON, skyline-near. Subject: low heavy industrial refineries and pipeworks, stepped roofs. Fine crisp pixel art with deliberate clusters at about 360 virtual pixels across, no chunky blocks, not photorealistic. Palette: near-black burgundy and navy, dull crimson/rose rims and sparse rust-red seams. Almost black material, restrained thin colored edges; much darker than arcade ships and projectiles. Landscape 1536x1024. Bottom-aligned shallow skyline band: baseline at very bottom, silhouettes occupy bottom 55 percent only, clear transparent sky above. Skyline extends across width with low structures at both edges, no giant center landmark or floor strip. No perspective convergence. Genuine alpha background outside structures, NOT opaque black, NOT painted checkerboard. No sky, stars, grid, floor plane, UI, text, logo, watermarks, ships, characters, targets, bullets, pickups, bright white or green/lime lights. No bright scattered dots or wide bloom.

Edit ONLY the small glaring white blob on the upper-left conduit cluster (around x=165 y=450 on the 1254 square canvas). Replace that white region with near-black burgundy metal paneling and a tiny dull red seam matching surrounding pipes. Remove any white light, white pixels or bright flare anywhere. Keep exact positions and geometry of all structures, dark palette, broad transparent margins, clear top and bottom rows, transparent center and true alpha. No other change.

Primary request: create one polished panoramic environment illustration using the accepted crimson background landmark and skyline artwork from this project as visual reference. Scene: CRIMSON TIDE: immense dark red ringed planet and a small dim moon above a distant burgundy refinery skyline, subtle red atmospheric glow and muted crimson seams. Preserve that system's established identity and crisp detailed pixel-art language; deliberate fine pixel clusters rather than chunky blocks, dark beveled industrial shapes, atmospheric depth, sparse emissive accents, no broad white highlights or excessive bloom. Composition: 2:1 landscape, intended runtime export 768x384 and displayed about 200x100 CSS pixels; the landmark should remain clear at that small size. Landmark fills upper two-thirds, skyline forms shallow lower band; keep bottom quarter dark and calm for runtime text overlay. Camera: distant cinematic environmental vista, not overhead. Fully opaque near-black navy space/sky backdrop, no transparency. No text, letters, typography, UI, cards, frame, borders, logos, watermark, ships, enemies, characters, bullets, HUD, crosshairs, grid or combat effects. This is a single unframed environment image.
